t: What his Lord promised him about his community
a: وَلَقَدْ وَعَدَنِي رَبِّي عَزَّ وَجَلَّ أَنْ يُدْخِلَ الْجَنَّةَ مِنْ أُمَّتِي سَبْعِينَ أَلْفًا بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
p: Wa laqad waʿadanī rabbī an yudkhila-l-jannata min ummatī sabʿīna alfan bi-ghayri ḥisāb
m: My Lord has promised me that seventy thousand of my community will enter the Garden with no reckoning.
